mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, user_id, file_id, file_name, position_ms, duration_ms, created_at, updated_at, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_playback_history (tenant_id, user_id, file_id, file_name, position_ms, duration_ms) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{fileId}, #{fileName}, #{positionMs}, #{durationMs})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM video_playback_history WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
